name: Bekasi Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance road race held on August 9, 2026 in Kota Harapan Indah, Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bekasi Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for August 9, 2026, in Kota Harapan Indah, Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. The event offers four distance options: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km. Registration is scheduled to open with an Early Bird period from April 29 to May 5, 2026, followed by Normal Price registration from May 6 to June 5, 2026.

faqs.answer: The Bekasi Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 9, 2026. The race will be held in Kota Harapan Indah, located in Bekasi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia, offering runners several distance categories to choose from on race day.
